candidate_windows.window_text:
Due to the limitation of computing resource, we only incorporate IAIS regularization in the phase of fine-tuning instead of pre-training. We use the base (12 layers) and the large (24 layers) version of UNITER (Chen et al., 2020), one of the most prevailing large-scale pre-trained models, as our baseline and backbone for IAIS. We follow the fine-tuning setting and hyper-parameter configuration of the original paper. The margin in Eq. (14) is 0.2. For each positive instance, 31 hard negative instances are sampled on the text and image side, respectively, and as each batch contains 8 different

positive instances, the batch size is 512. The learning rate is 5e-5 and the training steps are 5000 for both base and large models. All experiments are run on 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs.
